Hi Elena / Chris —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth going into planning: 

1) Scope of the trial (2 weeks, internal pilot): Redwood hosted inference, 1 dedicated endpoint, focus on clinical note summarization workload (avg 350 tokens / request).
2) Success criteria (we discussed a few — please see attached spreadsheet):
   - Precision threshold: > 88% on your 120-sample eval set
   - Latency: p95 < 450ms for single-user tests
   - Cost: expected per-token cost below $0.0009 for production-like throughput
   - Reliability: > 99% availability during scheduled windows
3) Owners:
   - Medilink: Elena (clinical lead), Chris (procurement lead)
   - Redwood: Kimberly (sales lead), Dev (technical lead), Marissa (CS/exec readout)
4) Timeline proposal:
   - Week of 7/7: SOW + access details finalized
   - Week of 7/14: POC kickoff, data access & small ingest
   - Week of 7/21–7/28: Trial run, daily syncs as needed
   - Week of 7/29: Final readout + go/no-go decision (exec slot)
5) Procurement: Elena mentioned an accelerated procurement path if we can provide a short SOW + security appendix by 7/3.

Attachments: Medilink_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (breakdown of metrics) and SOW_draft_v3.pdf (initial draft).

As next steps, can you please: 
- Confirm the success criteria in the attached spreadsheet (Elena) by 7/2
- Confirm the proposed timeline and exec availability for 7/29–7/30 (Chris / Elena)
- Procurement: provide procurement contact and any required PO template (Chris)

Dev — I’ve attached the SOW draft; would you please confirm the technical appendix and list the minimal infra we need in the first week?

Thanks all,

Kimberly / Elena —

I reviewed the SOW draft and the success criteria spreadsheet. Technical notes and minimal infra ask below: 

- Data: we only need a sample set (de-identified) of ~200 notes to tune and validate. Secure upload via S3 presigned URL is fine.
- Access: create a single API key scoped to the POC project; we’ll rotate it at the end of the trial.
- Endpoint: one dedicated inference endpoint, 1x T4-equivalent capacity for the pilot (covers spike scenarios).
- Logging: we’ll enable token-level logs for the eval window and provide an audit export. That satisfies the audit logs requirement noted by procurement.
- Timeline risk: if we get access to data after 7/14 we’ll likely shift the run window out by a week; please confirm data availability.

I’ll attach a short technical appendix to the SOW with these items (SOW_draft_v3.pdf will be updated).
